description: EZRecruit is the ATS built for recruitment and staffing agencies: jobs, your own candidate database, client trackers, interviews, closures and Nyra, the AI assistant.
h1: The ATS built for recruitment agencies.
intro: Agencies handle many clients and roles at once. EZRecruit keeps every job, candidate, client update and closure in one place, with Nyra to do the routine work.

blocks.h: Made for agencies, not corporate HR
blocks.p: Agencies work on many clients at once and send shortlists to each of them. EZRecruit follows that way of working: one pipeline from the client's brief to the joining date.
points: Every agency has its own database.
Share a clean tracker with each client.
Track offers and joining dates, and see closures and revenue.

blocks.p: Start with jobs and candidates, and add more as you grow. It all uses one database, one login and one pipeline.
points: Requirements: paste the client's job details and Nyra writes the job description and screening questions.
Candidates: upload CVs, even in bulk, and each one is read. Repeats are found by email and phone.
Interviews: set up interviews and let candidates pick their own slot.
Closures: track offers and joining dates.
Goals: set targets for your team and track them.

blocks.h: From new job to joining, in 3 steps
blocks.p: Add the job and Nyra writes the job description. Nyra reads the CVs in your account and scores the best matches out of 100, with reasons. Then share a tracker with your client, set up interviews and follow offers until joining.
Ask in English, Hindi or Hinglish. Nyra searches, schedules, shortlists and answers your numbers. She shows you every change first, and only shows what you are allowed to see.
points: Read what Nyra can and cannot do on the Nyra page.

metaTitle: AI Candidate Matching for Recruitment Agencies | EZRecruit
description: Nyra reads every CV in your account and scores the best matches out of 100, with the reasons. Search in plain words, refine in conversation and save searches.
h1: AI candidate matching that shows its reasons.
intro: Nyra reads the CVs in your account and scores the best matches out of 100, with the reasons, so you know who to call first.

blocks.p: Type it like you would say it, for example "Find Java developers in Bangalore with 5+ years". Nyra turns it into a scored search in seconds. If a request is too vague, she asks instead of guessing.
points: Refine in conversation: "Add Kafka", "Not Hyderabad".
Find people for a job by its code.
Find more candidates like one you like.
Save a search, and get a daily alert about new matches.

blocks.p: Each candidate gets a score out of 100 with the reasons beside it. Nyra reads the CVs and job descriptions in your account to score matches and write drafts.
Admins set a monthly AI budget, with limits per person and per feature, and see usage on a live dashboard. Every agency has its own database.

metaTitle: Client Trackers for Recruitment Agencies | EZRecruit
description: Choose the columns for the tracker you send, or ask Nyra to email it to the client with the Excel file attached.
h1: Client trackers without the messy spreadsheets.
intro: Choose the columns for the tracker you send, and share it with your client.

blocks.p: Ask Nyra to send the tracker for a job to the client. She shows you the email first, with the Excel tracker attached, and sends it when you confirm. Your mailbox needs to be connected in EZRecruit.
points: Choose the columns for the tracker you send.
Send the shortlist with the Excel tracker attached.
Email the interview schedule to a client contact.
Every email is previewed before it goes.

blocks.p: Candidates move through your stages as you work, and the tracker you send shows each person's current stage at the time you send it.

metaTitle: Interview Scheduling for Recruitment Agencies | EZRecruit
description: Let candidates pick their own interview slot, and ask Nyra to book, move or cancel interviews, send reminders and chase feedback.
h1: Interview scheduling that mostly runs itself.
intro: Send a link and candidates pick a slot that suits them. A confirmation goes out once the booking is done.

blocks.h: Book, move and cancel in one line
blocks.p: Ask Nyra to book an interview and she finds a free slot and shows you the booking before anything changes. She can also reschedule, cancel and mark a no-show.
points: Free slots come from the EZRecruit interview calendar.
Nyra needs at least one hour's notice to book or move an interview.
She will not double-book a candidate who already has an upcoming interview.

blocks.p: Candidates get a WhatsApp reminder an hour before the interview. Nyra can also nudge the interviewers who owe feedback, in one line.
points: Send a candidate a slot link on WhatsApp.
Set the interview panel for a job.
Email interview details to a candidate.
Recruiters get a pop-up 10 to 15 minutes before an interview starts. Reminders and interview alerts also appear as pop-ups that must be dismissed.

metaTitle: Import Your Candidates and CVs | EZRecruit
description: The Import Center brings your candidate database and CVs into EZRecruit, with live progress, a report at the end and an undo. Most teams are ready in a few days.
intro: You do not start from zero. The Import Center brings in your candidate database and CVs.

blocks.p: You see live progress while it runs, get a report at the end and can undo the import. Your account manager turns it on for you.
points: Bring in your candidate database and CVs.
Watch progress live.
Get a report when it finishes.
Undo the import if you need to.

blocks.p: Upload CVs, even in bulk, and each one is read. If someone is already in your database, EZRecruit spots it by email and phone.

Upload a CSV to create up to 100 requirements at a time, for one client per file. A check-only mode flags any rows that would be skipped and why, and lets you download just those rows to fix and re-upload. The same import works in Nyra: attach a CSV and she asks which client, shows a preview of what she will create and waits for your confirmation.
Most teams are ready in a few days. We help you bring your data in and train your team.

metaTitle: EZRecruit Pricing | ATS for Recruitment Agencies
description: EZRecruit pricing depends on your team size and the modules you use. Book a demo and we will send you a quote.
intro: The price depends on your team size and the modules you use. Book a demo and we will send you a quote.

points: The size of your team.
The modules you use.

blocks.p: Admins set a monthly AI budget, with limits per person and per feature, and see usage on a live dashboard.
A 30-minute walkthrough on your own jobs, with help bringing your candidates in. We send the quote afterwards.
